stanza: I try to stay busy
I do the dishes, I mow the lawn
I try to keep myself occupied
Even though I know you're not coming home
I try to keep the house nice and neat
I make my bed I change the sheets
I even learned how to use the washing machine
But keeping things clean doesn't change anything
What am I going to do when I run out of shirts to fold?
What am I going to do when I run out of lawn to mow?
What am I going to do if you never come home?
Tell me, what am I gonna do?

busy.line: Dear Stan, I meant to write you sooner, but I just been busy
busy.linePrev: It reminds me that it's not so bad, it's not so bad
busy.lineNext: You said your girlfriend's pregnant now, how far along is she?

busy.line: These days, we kiss and we keep busy
stanza: I light all the candles
Cut flowers for all my rooms
I care for myself the way I used to care about you
These days, we kiss and we keep busy
The waves come after midnight
I call from underwater
Why even try to get right?
When you've outgrown a lover (Oh)
The whole world knows but you (Oh)
It's time to let go of this endless summer afternoon

busy.line: "I don't know, go play, Hailie, baby, your daddy's busy
